prompt: Composition: Three-column product grid, consistent image ratios, filter rail, one-column mobile. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Set headings in Young Serif and reading text in Inter; rounded expressive serif heading with neutral text. Use Burgundy and Rose: page #FFF8FA, text #48232E, accent #9D244E, secondary surface #F7DBE5, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 18px, heading 48px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
